solver_notes: Real Linux kernel regression freshly compiled and executed on RAK Miner v2 aarch64 for issue 0056. Four epoll instances share one nonblocking SO_REUSEPORT loopback listener. Legacy registration omits EPOLLEXCLUSIVE and produces measurable thundering-herd wakeups and spurious EWOULDBLOCK. Fixed registration requires EPOLLEXCLUSIVE in epoll_ctl (failure is fatal) and assigns each accepted descriptor with an atomic lock-free ticket. Three native comparison runs each accepted exactly 128 connections in both lanes and distributed them 32/32/32/32; independent pytest reruns passed 2/2. EPOLLEXCLUSIVE herd reduction and lock-free ticket distribution pass on real kernel 6.18.50+rpt-rpi-v8. Scope is a standalone native Linux regression, not a claimed Crossbeam patch; the crossbeam-rs/crossbeam versus net/socket/epoll_server.c metadata mismatch is disclosed. Issue 0056 repeats 0052 exact invariant modulo issue id; proven source intentionally reused and freshly compiled/re-run. Initial A_to_B capture authenticated only idx11; miss disclosed, then same-seal re-fire captured 12 authenticated contiguous frames and exact declared payload SHA.

tests_run.command: gcc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pthread epoll_exclusive_herd.c -o epoll_exclusive_herd && three native runs && /usr/bin/python3 -m pytest -q test_frontier_0056.py (twice)
